technique: Exact GLB world-space BVH, deterministic cosine-weighted hemisphere, distance-weighted static AO; not GI or direct lighting
mapping: Receiver name + normalized float32 positions SHA + uint32 indices SHA + world matrix; non-indexed uv1 in original triangle order
limitations: Static finite-distance AO only; no full-room or day/night indirect lightmap
Moving books, devices, glass and practical fixtures excluded as occluders
Triangle charts use flat geometric normals; limited 48 texels/m sample density

edgeFix.domain: Visible front face at left-wall intersection only
edgeFix.cause: Normal-only origin bias left boundary samples on adjacent wall; near-zero ray hits were numerically unstable
edgeFix.preserved: All geometry, UV mapping, lights and other chart texels
